acceptanceCriteria.text: A versioned build/release surface produces one canonical Mottainai package tarball and immutable digest/integrity from exact source/lock identity.
Existing npm package smoke/E2E tests consume the exact canonical payload rather than a separately repacked copy.
`nix/mottainai.nix` consumes that exact payload identity, or a test proves the Nix input payload byte-identical to the npm publication payload before packaging succeeds.
A deliberate difference in included files, built `dist`, package metadata, or tarball bytes between Route 1 and Route 2 fails closed in CI.
Route 2 still supplies its own pinned Node/native execution environment around the Route 1 payload; this Issue does not move Node into the npm tarball.
Tagged/historical managed-generation resolution continues to use the release's own declared package identity rather than HEAD's recipe applied to foreign source.
Release workflow can build downstream Nix/runtime artifacts before public npm registry publication without weakening the one-payload invariant.
Documentation identifies Route 1 payload identity as the application artifact authority consumed by Route 2.

issue.title: feat(runtime): make the Nix package consume the canonical npm application payload
